name: TakeProfit public stale-quote and polling-order counterfactual
limitations: The experiment delays only one quote request naturally initiated by the public page.
It does not manufacture a second quote request or call a TakeProfit endpoint directly.
If the client serializes polling, out-of-order application cannot be tested in this run and remains unverified.
The public indicator card does not prove the authenticated workspace uses the same transport or freshness policy.
